messages:
Lina_Sales: Heads-up: HealthBridge procurement requested a POC evidence bundle: SOC2 exec summary, ISO excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation for the Dedicated trial, plus SAML test metadata and staging IPs. They asked for delivery by Friday COB.
Omar_Security: I can draft the pen-test attestation. Confirming: Dedicated single-tenant, right? That impacts scope language.
Lina_Sales: Yes single-tenant Dedicated pool. They also want KMS separation notes and confirmation we won't run tests against prod.
Priya_Eng: Operations prefers presigned uploads for logs. For staging IPs we can provide a /27 block. Need a decision on allowlist direction (customer vs our egress).
Jack_Docs: I have the SOC2 executive summary and a redacted ISO excerpt ready. Will drop PDFs into the ticket. Which format does procurement prefer?
Hannah_Legal: We'll review pen-test wording and sign after NDA/PO verification. We will not backdate. We can add language for mutually agreed retrospective testing windows if necessary.
billing-bot: Note: POC discount policy: 15-25% range; Sales to confirm exact percent and whether onboarding SRE hours are billable.
Lina_Sales: Action items: Omar drafts letter and posts in ticket; Jack uploads SOC2/ISO; Priya provides staging CIDR and SAML metadata; Hannah to sign once NDA/PO verified; I'll confirm discount in quote. Goal: packet to HealthBridge by Fri COB.
Omar_Security: Drafting now, will include scope appendix and contact for coordination.
Priya_Eng: I'll prepare the runbook snippet and staging IPs by EOD tomorrow.
Jack_Docs: Uploading docs to TICKET-998 now.
Hannah_Legal: OK, will triage when docs + NDA link present.
